entryHint: Read the lines from a photo and split them item by item.

pick.title: Scan a receipt
pick.heading: Photograph the receipt
pick.body: Lay it flat, fill the frame, and make sure the total is in the picture.
pick.readingHint: This can take up to half a minute.

check.title: Check the receipt
check.hint: Fix anything the camera got wrong. Nothing is saved yet.
check.gapExtra: Extra — service, tip or a missed line — shared in proportion

problems.title: Give it a name.
problems.total: The total has to be more than zero.
problems.lineAmount: Every line needs an amount above zero.

warnings.NO_ITEMS: The lines couldn't be read, so the whole total is one line. Split it as it is, or add the lines.
warnings.TOTAL_MISSING: The total couldn't be read, so it is the lines added up. Check it against the receipt.
warnings.DATE_MISSING: The date couldn't be read, so it is set to today.
warnings.LINES_UNREADABLE: Some lines couldn't be read and were left out. Add them if they matter.
warnings.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: This receipt looks like it is in {currency}, but the group is in {groupCurrency}. Nothing is converted.

split.title: Who had what
split.hint: Pick a name, then tap the lines that person shared. A line with no names on it is split between everyone.
split.noBrushHint: Tap a line to choose names for it.
split.lineSheetHint: A line with no names on it is split between everyone.
split.previewError: Couldn't work out the split. Check the lines.
split.adjustmentDiscount: Includes a {amount} discount, shared in proportion to each person's lines.
split.adjustmentExtra: Includes {amount} extra, shared in proportion to each person's lines.

attach.failed: The expense is saved, but the photo didn't upload.

detail.linesNote: The amounts above were worked out from these lines.

editor.itemizedWarning: This expense was split line by line from a receipt. Changing the amount, who paid or the split below replaces those lines.
